statement: SK Group and NVIDIA expanded their partnership into what NVIDIA describes as a 500-billion-plus-dollar initiative covering AI factory construction, next-generation memory supply and AI cloud deployment across Asia-Pacific, with the first AI factory targeted for 2027.
why: A committed buildout program of this size, announced by NVIDIA itself, points to sustained multi-year purchasing of accelerators, memory and data center power outside the US hyperscalers.

impact.mechanism: A large sovereign-scale AI factory program converts into orders for GPUs, HBM, data center capacity and electrical supply over several years.

confidence.basis: Primary source: NVIDIA investor relations press release.

dispersion: The document gives a program headline size, not a booked purchase commitment or a spend schedule, so no dollar value is recorded.
